rec.url: Give the subscribe page's address, starting with https://.
rec.where: Pick where it shows: the confirmation page, emails, or both.
rec.logo: That image isn't in the library any more. Pick it again.
rec.partnerPause: A partner is paused with its partner link, which needs grow:connect.
rec.order: The order has to list every recommendation once. Reload and try again.
rec.listUnknown: That list doesn't exist. Pick another list.
code.labelRequired: Say who the code is for. The label shows under Recommending you once they connect.
code.noInstance: Partner links need this instance's public URL. An instance admin sets it in Settings › Instance.

partner.private.message: {address} is a private address. Partner instances must answer at a public HTTPS address. Private and loopback addresses are refused.
partner.private.note: address: the address the partner's host resolved to, or the host

partner.unsupported.message: {host} runs a ReputeCast version without partner links. Ask them to update, or recommend their subscribe page as a link.

partner.codeExpired.message: This code expired on {date}. Partner codes work for 7 days. Ask the newsletter for a new one.
partner.codeExpired.note: date: the day it expired, “12 Oct”

partner.codeUsedBy.message: {name} used this code on {date} to connect {partner}. Each code connects once. To connect again, ask {partner} for a new one.
partner.codeUsedBy.note: name: who connected; date: “22 Sep”; partner: the newsletter

partner.codeUsed.message: This code was used on {date}. Each code connects once. Ask the newsletter for a new one.

partner.codeRevoked: The newsletter revoked this code. Ask them for a new one.

partner.codeUnknown.message: {host} doesn't know this code. Check that you copied all of it.

partner.unreachable.message: {host} didn't answer over HTTPS. Check the address with the newsletter, or try again in a few minutes.

partner.notACodeLink: That's a link to a subscribe page, not a partner code. Partner codes look like https://reputecast.example/p/XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
partner.notACode: That isn't a partner code. Partner codes look like https://reputecast.example/p/XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
link.ended: This partnership has ended. Reconnecting needs a new partner code.

link.pausedByPartner.message: {partner} paused this link. Only they can resume it.

link.limitOut: Only partners that recommend you have a daily limit you set.
notify.invalidBody: Their instance rejected our signature or ended the partnership. The recommendation is hidden until you paste a new partner code.
notify.unreachableBody: Subscribe requests are waiting and will be retried for 24 hours. Readers are told their request was passed on.
prefill.private: That page is on a private address. Recommend a page anyone can open.
